text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Japan Dirt Derby.
Smart Falcon
is exuding confidence in
her skill on dirt.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, unlike in the Satsuki Sho,
where the
runners were full of hope,
today there's a tint of
grim
determination to many of the faces in
the
entrance tunnel.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Some runners fall into dirt racing
because they
fail to find success on turf.
Some feel cornered, as
if they're at the
end of the road.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This gives them a sense of standing on a
cliff's
edge. Смарт Фалкон accepts all of
that collective
pressure as she heads into
the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
